name: vintage-1960s
description: Authentic 1960s drum-bus tone — UADx Pultec EQP-1A low girth + tamed top, Fairchild 670 tube glue, Ampex ATR-102 15 IPS tape, narrowed toward period-mono. Winner of a 4-lens adversarial judge panel (33.5/40), refined per the panel (relaxed over-narrowing + a touch more air). Built & verified 2026-05-31.
intended_for: a stereo drum bus / drum mix (also gives a full mix a convincing vintage vibe)
plugin_build: uaudio_*.vst3 (UADx native build — the one that renders headless; the UAD *.component twins pass audio through unprocessed offline, do NOT use them)

target_signature.comment: measured dry -> 1960s on the reference drum bus; use to sanity-check a re-apply

notes: The +18 dB input gain-stage is integral — it drives the Fairchild/Ampex (which compress/saturate the hot signal) at default settings; without it they barely engage.
Fairchild 670 and Ampex ATR-102 run at DEFAULT params on the gained-up bus (that is how the winner rendered).
Byte-exact plugin states are in vintage-1960s.states/ (restore via apply-vst-chain state_path); the recipe params reproduce the same result and are the portable form.
